mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, with overcast skies and a temperature of 77 degrees near the Verona Public Library, under the current New Moon phase.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers for various programs and requires a two-shift monthly commitment. Also, road construction on Highway M begins August 18, involving lane shifts and utility work that will impact local traffic for several weeks.
There is plenty to do, including Live Music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly report, we noted an incident on Wednesday, August 5, where officers successfully took a man into custody on Whalen Road after he attempted to flee from a probation violation warrant.
Today's featured flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and you have plenty of time to get it as the store remains open until 10:30 PM.
